label: Retina z-stack (OME-TIFF, 2 channels)
description: A two-channel confocal z-stack of retina (32 × 515 × 771 pixels, uint8), cropped from the OME Consortium's retina_large sample, with its micrometre voxel sizes and channel colours.
expectedResult: Convert it to a three-level OME-Zarr pyramid that keeps the 0.0229 × 0.0229 × 0.2 µm voxel size and both channels, view it, and download it as an .ozx archive.

attribution.source: Cropped from the OME Consortium sample sub-resolutions/Z-stack/retina_large.ome.tiff (from a Bitplane Imaris sample)
